public_semantics.unit: daily aggregate counts of request parameters, not individual public request rows
public_semantics.q_approved: free-text q values after a whitelist/stemming privacy filter intended to remove PII; lower-cased/cleaned

implications: The committed Yrkesvaljaren search file is a derived cumulative subset of the public daily JobSearch Trends source, not the raw source.
Raw public daily files preserve time and lower-frequency q_approved terms that Yrkesvaljaren discards, so they should become a first-class Gate-2 behavioral source.
q_approved means privacy-approved free text, not semantically approved or mapped intent.
Public daily fields are split marginals, so same-day q and taxonomy-id counts must never be treated as query-target co-occurrence.
The public field list omits structured skill and language parameters even though internal documentation describes them.
Yrkesvaljaren update_search_terms only adds files outside the previous min/max date range, so a file published later for a missing date inside that interval would not be backfilled.
Yrkesvaljaren concept weights are exact preferred-label behavioral priors; job-title counts are inherited by every related occupation-name and are not semantic ground truth.
